images.title: A 4 × 6 grid tiled with 2 × 1 tiles
images.purpose: Show a 4 × 6 grid fully covered by vertical 2 × 1 tiles, with no gaps and no overlaps.
images.composition: One grid centred in the frame, 4 rows and 6 columns.
exact_structure: A grid of exactly 4 rows and 6 columns of equal squares, with thin grey grid lines.
Exactly 12 tiles, each covering 2 squares one above the other, with thick dark outlines.
Each column holds 2 tiles: one in rows 1 and 2, one in rows 3 and 4.
Tiles are filled alternately teal (#0072B2) and amber (#E69F00) so that neighbouring tiles differ.
The label 4 rows at the left of the grid and 6 columns above it.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: With an even number of rows, every column fills with vertical tiles.
images.description: Show a 4 × 6 grid fully covered by vertical 2 × 1 tiles, with no gaps and no overlaps.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.

image_decisions.why: Tiling means no gaps and no overlaps; a finished tiling shows both.
